name: ChatGPT
question: What is ChatGPT?
title: What is ChatGPT? | BrandBizkit
description:
Understanding the basics of ChatGPT by OpenAI. What it is, what it can do, and how it works.
Explore the revolutionary AI technology that's transforming how we interact with machines and access information
paragraphs: ChatGPT is a large language model developed by OpenAI that uses deep learning techniques to generate human-like text based on the input it receives. It's part of the GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) series of models.

Unlike traditional chatbots that follow predefined scripts, ChatGPT can engage in dynamic conversations, answer complex questions, create content, and assist with a wide range of tasks by understanding context and generating relevant responses.
Since its introduction, ChatGPT has revolutionized how people interact with AI, making advanced language technology accessible to millions of users worldwide.

capabilities.heading: What Can ChatGPT Do?
capabilities.sub: A quick look at what's actually in the app today — this gets re-checked regularly as OpenAI ships updates.

items.title: Memory & Projects
items.text: Remembers your preferences and past conversations automatically, and lets you spin up dedicated Projects with their own files and context for a specific client or task.

items.title: Built-in Image Generation
items.text: Create and edit images inline with GPT Image — describe what you want without leaving the chat or opening a separate tool.

items.title: Voice Conversations
items.text: Hands-free, natural spoken conversations, including inside Projects and with file uploads — talk it through instead of typing.

items.title: Agentic Tasks
items.text: Hand off multi-step work — research, browsing, form-filling — and let it work through the task, checking in only when it needs your approval.

items.title: Coding with Codex
items.text: OpenAI's built-in coding agent reads, writes and runs code across a real project from the CLI, an IDE extension, or a cloud sandbox.

items.title: Content Creation
items.text: Draft articles, social posts, marketing copy and more in your brand voice, then refine tone and length in follow-up prompts.
